title: Extend a local normal modification supported at a closed point
statement: Let $X$ be an integral normal Noetherian scheme [def-pc-integral-scheme, def-weil-pbc-normal-ring, pqf-def-locnoeth], where normal means that every local ring is a normal domain, and Noetherian means locally Noetherian and quasi-compact. Let $x\in X$ be a closed point, put $B=\mathcal O_{X,x}$ and $V=\operatorname{Spec}B\setminus\{\mathfrak m_B\}$ [def-weil-pbc-module-stalk, def-weil-affine-spectrum]. Let $h:Y\to\operatorname{Spec}B$ be a proper morphism from an integral normal scheme, inducing an isomorphism of function fields [def-weil-proper-morphism, def-sc-function-field]. Assume $h^{-1}(V)\to V$ is an isomorphism. Then there exist an integral normal Noetherian scheme $X^{\prime}$ and a proper morphism $g:X^{\prime}\to X$ inducing an isomorphism of function fields, such that $g^{-1}(X\setminus\{x\})\to X\setminus\{x\}$ is an isomorphism and $$X^{\prime}\times_X\operatorname{Spec}B\cong Y$$ over $\operatorname{Spec}B$ [def-pc-fibre-product].
